boards: ROG STRIX B850-A GAMING WIFI7 S NEO
sources: ASUS ROG STRIX B850-A GAMING WIFI specifications: CPU_FAN, CPU_OPT, AIO_PUMP, CHA_FAN1-4
verification: Fan header order confirmed by the owner of this board on 2026-11-04. PWM mapping measured on 2026-11-05 by raising one PWM at a time to 80% (nct6799 pwm_sweep): pwm2 moved CPU_OPT and CHA_FAN3 together, pwm4 moved CHA_FAN2 only; pwm1, pwm3 and pwm6 moved nothing because CPU_FAN, CHA_FAN1 and CHA_FAN4 have no fan connected, so their mapping is assumed. pwm7 (AIO_PUMP) was deliberately not tested. The kernel exposes no pwm5; CHA_FAN3 is driven by pwm2. Voltage names and external dividers follow LibreHardwareMonitor; values were checked for plausibility, not measured.
